You are dynamic, eager to learn, and looking for a new challenge - read this below

As an IT Recruiter, you will learn about IT Technologies, the way of recruitment and become a Master in your area.

We have a spot for experienced and Non-experienced recruiter.

By joining our team, you will build/ expand the Belgian market, reach high potential candidates, match your client's expectations, this will allow you to improve at maximum your sales skills.

Training, Role-play, Webinar, Workshop, etc. at Oliver James, we put every tool at your service to evolve and become the best Recruiter on the Belgian market.

Let's talk about OJ's atmosphere: Fun! Crazy! Work! Sales Floor vibe! Every Friday come and enjoy some drinks with your colleagues and make good memories.

If you succeed and continue to overachieve your targets, you will be part of crazy incentives like Sky Diving with your team…

IT Recruiter - The job
 

• You follow the recruitment process from A to Z (360° Consultant)
• You will analyse your market and prospect in your portfolio
• You will contact, screen, interview, and prepare your candidates
• You will be advising clients and candidates on recruitment processes
• You will be responsible for your market and become an expert in your area

IT Recruiter - Your profile:
 

• You are driven by success and eager to learn every day
• You speak French OR Dutch AND English
• You hold a Bachelor/master's degree
• You want to evolve and be the pioneer of a new division
• And you have a sales mindset and You are a real team player

Your mission
 

We are looking for a dedicated Weekend Night Receptionist (f/m/d) to ensure smooth and secure overnight operations across our hotels during weekends. If you're detail-oriented, dependable, and enjoy working independently during the quiet hours, this is your chance to make a difference where it matters most. You will be responsible for overseeing the front desk operations during the overnight shift, ensuring smooth and efficient guest service, and performing end-of-day financial reconciliation. This role is a combination of guest service, administrative, and accounting duties, requiring attention to detail, accuracy, and professionalism. This role also includes light food & beverage duties, such as preparing and setting up the breakfast service for early morning guests.

Your profile
 
 

• Previous experience in hotel front office or night audit role preferred 

• Fluency in English and French (Dutch is a plus) 

• Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and financial reconciliation 

• Familiarity with Property Management Systems (PMS); experience with Opera, Opera Cloud is a plus 

• Excellent communication and customer service skills 

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision 

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) 

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail  

Job requirements
 

Key Responsibilities: 

Front Desk Operations 
 
 

• Welcome and check-in late arrivals in a professional and friendly manner 

• Handle guest requests, inquiries, and complaints promptly and efficiently 

• Process check-outs and prepare bills for early departing guests 

• Ensure lobby and reception areas are clean and presentable during the night 

• Follow daily night checklist   

Night Audit and Reporting 
 
 

• Perform nightly audit of all hotel revenue, including rooms, food & beverage, and other outlets 

• Reconcile and balance daily transactions and post any necessary corrections 

• Prepare daily summary reports for management (e.g. occupancy, revenue, etc.) 

• Roll the date in the property management system (PMS) and close the business day  

Security and Safety 
 
 

• Monitor the property to ensure the safety and security of guests and staff 

• Follow emergency procedures and report any suspicious activity to management or security personnel 

• Conduct property walks and ensures all access points are secure  

Cash Handling 
 
 

• Reconcile the front desk cash drawer and ensure all transactions are properly accounted for

Shape the architecture behind the next generation of AI supercomputers.
 

Join imec and design the future of AI computing
 

What if your architectural decisions could influence the future of artificial intelligence at the scale of the world's most advanced computing systems?

At imec, you will work at the intersection of AI, semiconductor innovation, and large-scale computing architectures. Together with leading experts in computing systems, chip technology, software, and artificial intelligence, you will help define how future AI infrastructure is built, optimized, and scaled.

This is not a product maintenance role. It is an opportunity to explore breakthrough architectures that could shape the next decade of AI and high-performance computing.
 

What you will do
 

As a Principal AI & High-Performance Computing Architect, you will drive innovation across the entire computing stack, from AI applications and system software to processors, accelerators, and semiconductor technologies.

You will create models, simulations, and design explorations that help identify the most promising paths toward future AI computing systems that deliver significant improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and sustainability.

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Exploring architectural solutions for next-generation AI and high-performance computing clusters. 

• Analysing the behaviour and performance characteristics of large-scale AI workloads. 

• Developing performance models that identify bottlenecks and opportunities for innovation. 

• Evaluating future processor, accelerator, memory, and system designs. 

• Collaborating with experts in computer architecture, AI, semiconductor technology, system software, and modelling. 

• Defining requirements for future AI computing platforms and processor architectures. 

• Guiding strategic research directions through data-driven performance analysis and projections. 

• Contributing to breakthrough innovations that improve performance, energy efficiency, operational cost, and environmental impact. 

Who you are
 
 

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant STEM degree, with at least around 8 years of experience.   

• Experience with performance analysis, engineering, and optimization of HPC applications, such as molecular dynamics and computational fluid dynamics,  

• Experience in AI for HPC is a plus.   

• Experience with distributed AI/ML applications, such as LLM training and inference.   

• Experience in system performance modeling ranging from a single device (e.g. a GPU) to a machine scale (e.g. a cluster).  

• Good understanding of GPU (preferably XPU) system architectures, distributed programming models, runtime resource management, and microarchitecture.   

• Strong programming ability in C++ and Python. CUDA knowledge is considered a plus.   

• Your communication and interpersonal skills enable you to work in a dynamic, distributed team. You actively share experiences and knowledge with colleagues. A history of mentoring more junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.   

• We are looking for your excellent communication skills in English, as you will work in a multicultural team and together with our partners.

Our client is a major real estate and infrastructure organization managing large-scale public-private partnership projects focused on the development, operation, and long-term maintenance of public facilities.

jobs.occupation: Junior Associate, Battery Passport & Sustainability Benchmarks M/W/X
jobs.description:
The Junior Associate will provide analytical and coordination support to the Battery Passport programme, with a particular focus on the Battery Benchmarks sustainability framework. The role combines standards and regulatory research, consultation analysis, drafting, data organisation and practical support to working groups, governance meetings and operations. 

This is a hands-on junior role in a small, internationally oriented team. It requires comfort moving between technical sustainability content, data handling and processing, and routine delivery tasks, including meeting administration, document control, stakeholder follow-up and event logistics. 

Key responsibilities 

Battery Benchmarks development 

• Analyse, catalogue and synthesise feedback from GBA member and public consultations. 
• Map voluntary ESG and responsible-sourcing standards relevant to battery and critical-mineral value chains. 
• Maintain regulatory and standards mappings and propose evidence-based updates to Battery Benchmarks modules and supporting documentation. 
• Support development of thematic modules. 
Assurance and credibility 

• Conduct background research on data assurance, verification, conformity assessment and certification approaches relevant to the Battery Passport. 
• Prepare comparisons, notes and materials for review by programme leads and external experts. 
Consultation and capacity building 

• Support the design and delivery of consultation surveys, webinars, outreach materials and the analysis of responses. 
• Draft and organise capacity-building and e-learning content using existing GBA frameworks and technical source material. 
Policy and regulatory monitoring 

• Monitor developments affecting batteries, critical minerals, sustainability reporting and responsible sourcing, and maintain a structured regulatory tracker. 
• Draft concise internal summaries and, where requested, first drafts of policy-facing materials. 
Working-group and Secretariat support 

• Prepare agendas, slide materials, minutes, action logs and member-input records for working groups, steering committees and governance meetings. 
• Support member-management processes, mailing lists, document repositories, event preparation, on-site delivery and post-event reporting. 
• Synthesise publications and market information into briefs, web copy or social-media drafts, and undertake other reasonable Secretariat tasks as required. 
• Excellent verbal and written communications in a culturally diverse and politically sensitive environment. 
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement AI-enabled workflows, including task-specific agents, to improve data handling, optimise internal processes, and support the ongoing maintenance of GBA standards and regulatory mappings.  
Required qualifications and experience 

• A completed master's degree in sustainable development, environmental policy or governance, international development, sustainability management, responsible business, supply-chain governance, or a closely related field. 
• Demonstrable professional experience analysing sustainability or ESG standards, regulatory frameworks and responsible-sourcing requirements in complex value chains. 
• Demonstrable research familiarity with battery or critical-mineral value chains, or with a closely comparable global industrial supply chain involving material environmental and human-rights risks. 
• Experience organising and analysing qualitative and quantitative information, including structured datasets, document review and synthesis of stakeholder input. 
• Ability to turn complex technical or policy material into accurate, concise written outputs for non-specialist and specialist audiences. 
• Strong organisational discipline, including document management, meeting preparation, minute-taking and follow-through on actions and deadlines. 
• Professional fluency in written and spoken English. 
• Ability to work from Brussels and to participate in occasional early-morning or late-afternoon international meetings; willingness to travel occasionally for GBA events. 
• The successful candidate must be legally entitled to work in Belgium before commencing employment. 
• Demonstrated experience using AI and data-analysis tools to develop efficient workflows, manage and interpret complex datasets, and support the ongoing maintenance of standards and regulatory frameworks. 
 

Desirable qualifications 

• Working knowledge of the EU Batteries Regulation and one or more relevant sustainability or reporting frameworks (for example GRI, ESRS/CSRD, responsible-minerals due diligence standards, EcoVadis or life-cycle assessment approaches). 
• Experience with stakeholder consultations, multi-stakeholder initiatives or expert workshops. 
• Applied capability in Excel and at least one data-analysis or visualisation tool such as Power BI, R or GIS. 
• Experience with collaborative platforms such as Microsoft 365, Teams and SharePoint. 
• Working knowledge of French or another language relevant to GBA's international stakeholder base. 
• Experience using carefully governed AI-assisted research or monitoring tools, with appropriate source checking and data-handling discipline.  
Working arrangements 

• The role is based in Brussels and involves close collaboration with a small Secretariat and external technical advisers. 
• Workload will vary with consultation, governance and event deadlines. Administrative and coordination work is an integral part of the position, not an incidental duty. 
• Some meetings are scheduled across international time zones, and occasional travel or on-site event support may be required.

Our analytics estate runs on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI: hundreds of workspaces, a large self-service community, and a regulated environment where access control, traceability and data integrity are not optional.

The platform is also moving fast. Copilot and data agents put generative AI in front of business users, Fabric IQ adds an ontology- based semantic layer, and Fabric Apps turn workspaces into a home for real, write-enabled applications each with its own tenant settings, capacity cost and compliance question. Someone has to decide how they get switched on, for whom, and under which controls.

We are looking for an administrator who treats the platform as a product: someone who automates rather than clicks, who can tell you exactly which capacity is throttling and why, and who keeps a GxP-relevant estate auditable without becoming a bottleneck for the business. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a ticket queue.

Responsibilities

 
• Tenant & capacity administration:
  
   
• Tenant settings, domains, workspaces, capacities (F Skus) and delegated capacity settings.
   
• Capacity health and cost: smoothing, bursting, throttling, background vs. interactive operations. Right-size, forecast, and support chargeback to business units.
   
• Onelake, deployment pipelines, GIT integration and CI/CD for Fabric items (Fabric-CICD, Fabric REST APIs).
   
• On-premises and VNET GateWay clusters, connections, and service principal / workspace identity access to source systems (SNOW, Veeva, Edp, ERP).
   
• Incident response and root-cause analysis on refresh failures, performance degradation and access issues; evaluation of preview features before they reach users.
  
 
• Automation & monitoring, the core of this job:
  
   
• Fuam (Fabric Unified Admin Monitoring) as the backbone of tenant observability: deploy it, keep it current with upstream releases, extend it, and turn its output into operational decisions.
   
• Administration automated with PowerShell (Microsoftpowerbimgmt, AZ, Microsoft.Graph) and Python (semantic-link-labs, notebooks) against the Admin, Scanner and REST APIs: provisioning, access reviews, orphaned-item cleanup, licence reclamation, tenant-setting drift detection.
   
• That automation runs properly, Azure DevOps pipelines, Azure Automation/Functions with logging, alerting and error handling.
   
• Observability beyond Fuam where needed: Workspace Monitoring (Eventhouse), Log Analytics, Capacity Metrics, Purview Audit.
  
 
• AI & new workloads:
  
   
• Copilot configuration: the Copilot and Azure Openai Service tenant settings, delegation to capacity administrators, security- group scoping, and the data-residency choices behind them.
   
• The cost of AI: Copilot and agents bill against capacity, so track Cu impact and assess whether a dedicated Fabric Copilot capacity makes sense.
   
• Fabric data agents: who may build them, on which sources, how they are validated, and what changes when they are surfaced through Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or MCP.
   
• Fabric IQ readiness (Ontology, graph, agents) and administration of Fabric Apps workload enablement, operational vs. data apps, the Rayfin CLI, and a review path for anything that writes data back.
  
 
• Governance & compliance:
  
   
• The workspace, domain and naming model, and the promotion path from self-service sandbox to certified content.
   
• Access through Entra ID groups and service principals: least privilege, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews and recertification.
   
• Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and DLP across Fabric and Power BI items.
   
• Qualification and validation...
  
...

• 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Fabric & Power BI administration

• Strong knowledge of Fabric tenant, workspace, Onelake, F-Sku capacity and GateWay administration

• Hands-on PowerShell & Python automation using Fabric Admin/REST APIs, Microsoft Graph and Microsoftpowerbimgmt

• Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD, GIT, Azure Automation/Functions and monitoring

• Strong expertise in Fabric capacity monitoring, performance, throttling, Cu consumption and cost optimization

• Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, RBAC, access reviews and security governanc

• Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, DLP, sensitivity labels and audit/lineage

• Experience with Fuam, Log Analytics, Eventhouse and Fabric monitoring

• Understanding of Fabric Copilot, Data Agents, Fabric IQ and AI workload governance

• Knowledge of GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and Alcoa+ compliance

Soft skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Proactive and automation-oriented mindset

• Strong ownership and accountability for platform operations

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Strong attention to detail, especially in governance and compliance

• Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions

• Strong incident management and root-cause analysis capabilities

• Ability to balance business needs with security, cost and compliance

• Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing skills

• Comfortable working in a fast-changing technology environment

• Language requirement:

• Required: English (C1 or higher)

• Nice to have: French Or Dutch
